title: File:Adelaide Neilson, circa 1880 (PORTRAITS 497).jpg

English:

Actress; b. 1848, Leeds, England; d. 1880, Paris, France

Handwritten on album page: Addio! Mio Caro. Lilian Adelaide Neilson

Album pages contain gold-edged bevel cut spaces for photographs and autographs

PH Coll 98.19

Adelaide Neilson/Lilian Adelaide Neilson (3 March 1847-15 August 1880), born Elizabeth Ann Brown, was a British stage actress.
